title: Dope – Melon
description:
DOPE Melon Strong is a strong nicotine pouch (16mg/g) with sweet taste of melon.

DOPE Melon delivers 22 slimmed all white nicotine pouches with a very discreet fit under your lip. Since DOPE Melon is 100% free from tobacco you won’t have to worry about staining your teeth!

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,2

- Content: 15,4g

- Format: Slim

- Portions/Can: 22
